lyrics:
[Intro: looping acoustic guitar figure, soft kick]

[Verse 1: conversational male voice, close mic]
Yeah, I slept on the couch with the dog and the game on
You slept in the bed with the door shut and the fan on
I don't even know what it started about
Something 'bout your sister, something out of my mouth

[Chorus: melodic, hi-hats in, voice doubled]
So this morning let's let the coffee talk
Two cups, no phones, back steps, no clock
You don't have to start, I don't have to win
Just pour it and pass it and lean on in
We both said plenty when the lights were off
This morning let the coffee talk

[Verse 2: same easy delivery]
Twenty-two years and I still do that thing
Where I go real quiet and I twist my ring
And you still do yours, where you clean the whole house
Loud as you can, till I figure it out

[Chorus: melodic, hi-hats in, voice doubled]
So this morning let's let the coffee talk
Two cups, no phones, back steps, no clock
You don't have to start, I don't have to win
Just pour it and pass it and lean on in
We both said plenty when the lights were off
This morning let the coffee talk

[Bridge: beat drops, guitar only]
Sugar for you, black for me
Sorry tastes better at six-fifteen

[Final Chorus: full beat, a harmony above]
So this morning let's let the coffee talk
Two cups, no phones, back steps, no clock
You don't have to start, I don't have to win
Just pour it and pass it and lean on in
We both said plenty when the lights were off
This morning let the coffee talk

[Outro: guitar loop, a spoon on a mug, spoken]
It was about your sister.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 102 BPM, 4/4, F# major. Easy, circling and close, like talking with your voice still low from sleep.

VOICE: Male, mid-range with a Southern drawl, nearly spoken in the verses and lightly sung in the chorus, doubled an octave up on the hook. No big notes. One spoken line and a short laugh at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: A fingerpicked acoustic guitar loop that never stops, a soft kick, quiet trap hi-hats and finger snaps from the chorus, a warm sub bass, a little pedal steel far back.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar loop. 0:09 Verse 1. 0:33 Chorus 1. 1:02 Verse 2. 1:26 Chorus 2. 1:55 Bridge, guitar only. 2:07 Final chorus. 2:36 Outro, a spoon on a mug, the spoken line at 2:44.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2023 country-pop: acoustic guitar and voice very close and dry, drums small and modern, nothing loud.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The spoken last line at 2:44, which reopens the argument as a joke.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is the fight and the bottle. This is the morning after, decades on, between two people who have a system for mending things.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Sheepish, familiar, offered, forgiven.
